title: Duress Brochures
summary: A range of promotional and informational brochures for Duress, focused on clear content hierarchy to guide readers through key device information.

meta.Deliverables: A5 overview brochure, promotional and informational brochures

blocks.label: Overview
blocks.heading: Hierarchy first, everything else second.
paras: While working at Duress, I designed a range of brochures for both promotional and informational purposes, with a strong focus on content hierarchy to clearly guide the reader through key information on the devices.

blocks.label: Overview brochure
blocks.heading: The one that ended up everywhere.
paras: One of the most impactful pieces was an A5 overview brochure that clearly presented our core devices and their key features. It quickly became a go-to resource for resellers and trade show presentations.
